title: Latency Gap Switchboard: resilient region selection using dual-percentile & link-reliability scoring
creator: Maya Chen
description: Goal: Implement a resilient region-selection component (the 'Switchboard') that synthesizes p50 and p95 latency telemetry with network path health (packet loss, jitter) into a single, interpretable score used by the router. The score must: (1) prioritize low-latency regions for latency-sensitive customers, (2) avoid noisy short-term spikes via temporal smoothing and hysteresis, and (3) prefer regions with stable link reliability to reduce tail-regression risk. We will also wire the Switchboard to prefer cheaper/different model variants as graceful fallbacks when regional health degrades. This ticket covers design, implementation, canary rollout, and metrics to validate behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Switchboard exposes a region score API that returns a deterministic ordered list of preferred regions for a given routing context (model, tier, customer).

Score computation uses p50 and p95 explicitly and documents weightings; default weights produce similar routing to existing baseline for 80% of traffic and prefer lower-cost regions for 10% when safe.
Router can call the Switchboard API and failover to the second-ranked region within configured SLO window without user-visible error.
Dashboard shows per-region composite score, component signals (p50, p95, packet_loss, jitter), and long/short window deltas for debugging.
Canary rolling deploy (10% traffic -> 50% -> 100%) with automated rollback on score-regression alerts is in place.
steps: Design composite scoring: define gap_score = clamp((p95 - p50) / p50, 0, 3) and reliability_penalty = f(packet_loss, jitter) -> combined_score = alpha * p50_norm + beta * p95_norm + gamma * gap_score + delta * reliability_penalty.
Implement telemetry ingestion: ingest p50/p95 histograms and SLI signals from edge telemetry (kafka topic 'edge-latency'), plus packet loss/jitter from path-probes.
Build Switchboard service (stateless API + local cache) and library client for router to resolve preferred region list.
Add tier awareness: include customer tier and reserved capacity flags to bias selection (dedicated pools should be preferred for enterprise customers).
Create simulation harness: replay last 48h traffic across candidate scoring weights to measure percent-of-requests that would switch region and estimated cost delta.
Integrate model-variant fallback matrix: map model variant compatibility and cost to allow fallback when primary region score falls below threshold.
Instrument dashboards and alerts: score drift, unexpected flip-flops, rollback triggers (error rate > 0.5% or latency SLO breach).
Canary rollout plan and observe (10% -> 50% -> 100%) with automated rollback if regression conditions met.
comments: 2026-02-16 Maya Chen: Initial writeup and proposed math for gap_score. Shared with SRE and Runtime teams for feedback.

2026-02-19 Arjun Patel: Reviewed telemetry sources. We should use 1m and 5m windows for short/long smoothing respectively. Added note: prefer EWMA decay over simple moving average to reduce sensitivity to outliers.

2026-02-25 SRE (Rachel Gupta): Concern about relying on p95 alone when sample rates drop in low-traffic regions. Recommendation: include sample_count threshold and fall back to synthetic estimation (bootstrap) when below threshold.

2026-03-01 Runtime (Diego Alvarez): Kernel selection / model-variant compatibility matrix added to attachments. Need a polymorphic fallback map so router knows which variant to request in a different region.

2026-03-04 Maya Chen: Simulation results attached in Confluence. With default weights (alpha=0.5, beta=0.3, gamma=0.15, delta=0.05) we simulated 48h traffic and found 12% fewer tail latency incidents at p99 while only increasing cost by 2.1% across sample customers.

2026-03-08 QA (Lena Rodriguez): Integration tests fail intermittently when packet-loss probe data is delayed. Proposed mitigation: add freshness TTL to reliability signals and treat stale signals as neutral (no penalty).
2026-03-10 Arjun Patel: Started implementation of Switchboard service scaffold. Created PR #8142. Next: add ingestion pipeline and unit tests for scoring math.
